current_review.title: RAPIDO V51: complete ten-case development and component evidence
current_review.summary: F has higher ten-case mean important-content coverage than ordinary one-call A0, with eight positive R directions, one negative and one unresolved. Two A0 assertion inventories are missing; the full A0 H mean is unknown. F delivered ten reports, nine full chains, and six zero-change edits. Model-reference development evidence does not establish confirmatory significance or independent generalization.
current_review.review_request: Review the V51 ten-case development snapshot. Read the current report, all50predefined endpoint rows, actual delivered reports, selected requests/responses/receipts, source-grounded model references and adjudication changes. Verify R/P/H definitions, missingness, consistent claim units, serious errors and costs against original records. Separate F-versus-A0 overall effects from F-versus-P and E-versus-C0 component effects. Do not strengthen A0, omit negative cases, impute missing labels as zero, or count rejected patches as repairs. References are not human gold and the parent was not fully blind. Independent significance is unproven. Check portability and permission boundaries. Review only; do not start a model, reconstruct hidden targets, change experiments or annotations, train, publish, or merge.
